title: Hermes Business acceptance evidence envelope
description: Small, redacted, machine-readable envelope for one acceptance category. Verified by scripts/verify-evidence.mjs and scripts/lib/evidence.test.mjs.

category.description: Which acceptance surface this evidence covers.

status.description: passed = suite ran green; blocked = could not run safely (see summary.reason); skipped = intentionally not exercised.

app_version.description: Companion version from package.json at capture time; the verifier requires it to equal the current tree.

hermes_range.description: Supported Hermes range from hermes-compat.json; verifier requires a match.

git_head.description: Full git HEAD SHA at capture time.

git_state.description: committed = HEAD had no uncommitted changes and git_head must equal current HEAD; working-tree = captured pre-commit with local changes present.

subject_scheme.description: Version of the subject fingerprint scheme (scripts/lib/subject-registry.mjs SUBJECT_SCHEME). A passed envelope must carry the current scheme; a mismatch forces recapture.

subject_fingerprint.description: Deterministic sha256 over the exact repository files this category attests (EVIDENCE_SUBJECTS). The verifier recomputes it over the working tree; a passed envelope whose subjects drifted is rejected regardless of git_state.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 capture timestamp (machine clock), or null.

tool.description: The script that produced the raw run this envelope reduces.

redacted.description: Always true: the summary passed through sanitize + redactPaths.

summary.description: Scalar-only reduction (booleans / counts / enums). Never contains paths, logs, prompts, chat content, usernames, tokens, emails or binaries. A passed packaged-e2e summary additionally MUST carry the tested build's binding triple — build_nonce (echoed by the running app), release_binding_digest (from release/release-report.json) and installer_sha256 — which the release preflight value-matches to the artifact being released (a mismatch makes the envelope stale, never an auto-pass).
